image.name: wikijs
image.description: [Wikijs](https://github.com/Requarks/wiki) A modern, lightweight and powerful wiki app built on NodeJS.

changelog.desc: Rebase to Alpine 3.24, switch upstream repo to v2 maintenance repo.
Restore git and openssh packages for git storage support.
Create dummy /etc/os-release to fix System Info page.
Rebasing to alpine 3.16, migrate to s6v3.
Added python dependency for some NPM modules as well as git for storage module

env_vars.name: DB_TYPE
env_vars.desc: Set to sqlite (default) or postgres depending on the database engine you wish to use

image.title: Wikijs
image.setup_instructions:
Please note that the database configuration environment variables will apply _on first run only_, after which you will need to directly edit /config/config.yml to change your settings.

For more information please see the [official documentation](https://docs.requarks.io/).

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  wikijs:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/wikijs:latest
    container_name: wikijs
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - DB_TYPE=sqlite #optional
      - DB_HOST= #optional
      - DB_PORT= #optional
      - DB_NAME= #optional
      - DB_USER= #optional
      - DB_PASS= #optional
    volumes:
      - /path/to/wikijs/config:/config
      - /path/to/data:/data
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=wikijs \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -e DB_TYPE=sqlite `#optional` \
  -e DB_HOST= `#optional` \
  -e DB_PORT= `#optional` \
  -e DB_NAME= `#optional` \
  -e DB_USER= `#optional` \
  -e DB_PASS= `#optional` \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -v /path/to/wikijs/config:/config \
  -v /path/to/data:/data \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/wikijs:latest
